MAC RELEASE

Mac 1.5.19 · build 35

Meet eight owl states, a vacation-eve expression, clearer settings and standard editing commands.

Latest public release2026-10-22
Mac DMGMac ZIP

macOS 13 or later · Universal for Apple Silicon and Intel

HighlightsImprovementsSupport and limitsDownloads

Highlights

Mac 1.5.19 introduces lowercase happylulu branding and eight owl states: waiting, regular work, lulu day, morning half-day off, afternoon half-day off, past planned time, annual/authorized leave and day off.

When the selected integration source confirms approved full-day annual or authorized leave for the next day, an expression with sunglasses and a hat starts 10 minutes before today’s expected departure and can remain until source-local midnight while its conditions remain true and the source result stays refreshed within 15 minutes. Half-day leave or a weekend alone does not trigger this expression.

The menu bar departure visibility option introduced in 1.5.17 remains supported.

On Mac, Settings → General → Show expected departure in menu bar is on by default. When on, it shows Leave 18:00 · 91 min left; when off, it shows only 91 min left. Changes apply immediately and the choice survives restart.

At or after expected departure, leaving this option on shows only the expected departure time. Turning it off shows Ready to leave. Waiting for arrival, Day off today and Leave day labels stay unchanged.

Improvements

  • Organizes General settings into three columns: labels on the left, previews in the center and controls on the right, with a usage guide in the sidebar.
  • Routes standard Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste and Select All commands to the active input field.
  • Improves the theme selection outline and settings gear focus, and lazily loads the initial header images for cache reuse.

Scope and limits

macOS 13 or later, Universal for Apple Silicon and Intel. Owl states, the vacation-eve expression, settings and editing improvements apply to Mac. The latest public Windows release remains 1.5.13 and is not part of this change.

The app identifier, local record location, menu bar time display and plugin preferences remain supported. Attendance stays on this computer; only enabled external integrations communicate with their services.

Uses a fixed self-signed certificate and Sparkle update signatures. Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are not applied. Downloading alone does not replace the installed app or accept permissions on your behalf. This page does not establish completed verification of a new installation, update, permission preservation, Intel hardware, actual unlock detection or login after reboot.
